title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners (GPT-3)
summary: Tom B. Brown and coauthors submitted Language Models are Few-Shot Learners on May 28, 2020. The paper reports GPT-3, an autoregressive language model with 175 billion parameters, and evaluates task-agnostic zero-shot, one-shot and few-shot performance without gradient updates or fine-tuning during those evaluations.
significance: A documented language-model milestone reporting GPT-3 and large-scale task-agnostic few-shot evaluation through text interaction.

verification.note: Title, authors, May 28 2020 submission/publication milestone, GPT-3's 175-billion-parameter scale and the described zero/one/few-shot evaluation setup are supported by the original arXiv record and OpenAI's first-party milestone page.
